title: One Hour Waterskiing Lesson: Ultimate Miami Thrills
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
age Minimum to do the activities: 8 year old.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Whether you're a complete novice or a seasoned slalom skier, get ready to carve up the water like a pro. While wakeboarding has taken the spotlight, water skiing remains a classic thrill—a timeless sport that's as glamorous today as it was in the '60s. At Miami Watersports Paradise, our expert instructors and top-of-the-line equipment will help you master the ropes. We know every channel and island in Miami's Bay area, so we can always find the flattest water for the best ride. Ready to hit the water? Let's get you on the skis!
